nas_mount_check.name: Enable NAS Storage Protection
nas_mount_check.description: Turn this on if you are saving music to a Network Attached Storage (NAS) share. It automatically halts the script if the NAS goes offline, preventing your Home Assistant local storage from filling up to 100%.

nas_status_entity.name: Home Assistant NAS Status Entity (Optional)
nas_status_entity.description: Enter the entity ID of a Home Assistant helper switch, ping sensor, or binary sensor tracking your NAS status (e.g., 'input_boolean.nas_online'). If this entity is off, false, or disconnected, the ripper will abort.

min_file_size_mb.name: Minimum File Size Threshold (MB)
min_file_size_mb.description: Sets the minimum file size limit in megabytes. Files smaller than this value (such as short ads, station jingles, or interrupted streams) will be automatically filtered out and deleted.

continuous_recording.name: Continuous Recording Mode
continuous_recording.description: Enable this to keep the stream ripper running infinitely in the background. It will automatically restart the recording capture loop if the radio stream disconnects or drops.
